The appearance of (i,j) in the following list means that m(X(i)) = X(j), where X(i) is on K155: (1,2321), (2,10), (6,306), (31,4153), (105,20495), (238,4071), (292,20496), (365,20497), (1423,20498), (1931,20499), (2053,20581), (2054,20500), (3009,20501), (2112,20502) Twenty-one more points on m(K155) are given as vertices of central triangles, represented here by A-vertices: m(A) = - b - c : a + c : a + b m(A') = (b + c) (a^(3/2) + b^(3/2) + c^(3/2)) : -(a + c) (a^(3/2) + b^(3/2) - c^(3/2)) : -(a + b) (a^(3/2) - b^(3/2) + c^(3/2)) m(A1) = (b + c) (a^2 + 2 b c) : -a^2 (a + c) : -a^2 (a + b) m(A2) = (b + c) (b^3 + a b c + c^3) : -(a + c) (b^3 + a b c - c^3) : -(a + b) (-b^3 + a b c + c^3) m(A3) = (b + c) (a^3 + a^2 b + a b^2 + a^2 c + 2 a b c + b^2 c + a c^2 + b c^2) : -(a + c) (a^3 + a^2 b + a b^2 + a^2 c + b^2 c - a c^2 - b c^2) : -(a + b) (a^3 + a^2 b - a b^2 + a^2 c - b^2 c + a c^2 + b c^2) m(A4) = (b + c) (a^2 b + a b^2 + b^3 + a^2 c + a b c + b^2 c + a c^2 + b c^2 + c^3) : -(a + c) (a^2 b + a b^2 + b^3 + a^2 c + a b c + b^2 c - a c^2 - b c^2 - c^3) : -(a + b) (a^2 b - a b^2 - b^3 + a^2 c + a b c - b^2 c + a c^2 + b c^2 + c^3) m(A5) = (b + c) (-a^3 + b^3 - 2 a b c - b^2 c - b c^2 + c^3) : (a + c) (a^3 - b^3 + 2 a^2 c + b^2 c - b c^2 + c^3) : (a + b) (a^3 + 2 a^2 b + b^3 - b^2 c + b c^2 - c^3), where A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 are defined at X_20333.
